d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Greece vs Qatar in Group A of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Greece came from behind to win 4-1 at Aspire Zone in Doha after Omar Ayman gave hosts Qatar an early lead, as Konstantinos Souvlatzis struck twice and Argyrios Argyriou and Konstantinos Karangelis were also on target in the second half. Greece top Group A with a perfect nine points, while Qatar finish third and must wait to see if they advance as one of the best third-placed teams.
